_llm_instructions:
Fill out the 'project_title', 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' properties for each field in this PROJECT SCOPE STATEMENT template based on the provided project context. Context & Definition: The project scope statement assists in defining and developing the project and product scope. The project scope statement is an output from the process 5.3 Define Scope in the PMBOK® Guide – Sixth Edition. It is developed once and is not usually updated unless there is a significant change in scope. Alignment: The project scope statement should be aligned and consistent with the following documents:
• Project charter
• Work breakdown structure
• Requirements documentation

Project scope description.guidance: Project scope is progressively elaborated from the project description in the project charter and the requirements in the requirements documentation.

Project deliverables.guidance: Project deliverables are progressively elaborated from the project description key deliverables in the project charter.

Product acceptance criteria.guidance: Acceptance criteria is progressively elaborated from the information in the project charter. Acceptance criteria can be developed for each component of the project.

Project exclusions.guidance: Project exclusions clearly define what is out of scope for the product and project.
